who: Kenneth L. Kusmer, historian of urban America at Temple University, PhD University of Chicago.

evidence.says: Urban History Association memorial by his former doctoral student identifies Kusmer as a Temple historian with a Chicago PhD and discusses his Black Communities series and urban history books.
Indexed acknowledgements of Sarah Hughes's American Monsters dissertation identify Ken Kusmer as her advisor.
LC identifies Kenneth L. Kusmer through Black communities and urban race relations in American history.

notes: Institution, doctoral school, publications and a listed student's advisor agree. The Chicago doctorate year was not independently established here; the thesis evidence is an indexed excerpt.

who: James Burkhart Gilbert, historian of American culture at Maryland, PhD Wisconsin 1966.
